identity.title: First detection of cyanamide (NH<SUB>2</SUB>CN) towards solar-type protostars

paper_type_evidence.quote: The ALMA data are part of the PILS ("Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey") program
The observations and their reduction are presented in (cite: Jorgensen2016).

question.value: Is cyanamide (NH2CN) and its isotopologues present in the warm gas around solar-type protostars, what are its abundance and deuteration, and can grain-surface NH2 + CN chemistry explain it?

evidence.quote: We here present the first detection of this species in the warm gas surrounding two solar-type protostars
This paper makes use of the ALMA data ADS/JAO.ALMA$\#$2013.1.00278.S.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 329.1-362.9 GHz, ~0.2 km/s resolution (ALMA PILS); PdBI IRAS2A: 223.5-227.1, 240.2-243.8, 315.5-319.1 GHz, 1.95 MHz resolution (WIDEX)

evidence.quote: observed in Cycle 2 between 329.1 and 362.9 GHz at a spatial resolution of about 0.5$\ensuremath{''}$ and a spectral resolution of $\sim$0.2 km s$^{-1}$
They cover the spectral ranges 223.5–227.1, 240.2–243.8, and 315.5–319.1 GHz with a spectral resolution of 1.95 MHz
Based on the non-detection of the HNCNH line at 223.7918 GHz, we derived a similar upper limit for IRAS2A.

angular_resolution.value: ~0.5'' (ALMA); about 1.2x1.0'' at 225 GHz, 1.4x1.0'' at 242 GHz, 0.9x0.8'' at 317 GHz (PdBI)

evidence.quote: The angular resolution is about 1.2$\ensuremath{''}$ $\times$ 1.0$\ensuremath{''}$ at 225 GHz

sensitivity.value: 4-5 mJy/beam km/s (ALMA); ~5-6 mJy/beam km/s or lower (PdBI)

evidence.quote: The data reach a sensitivity of about 4–5 mJy beam$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$.
observed in Cycle 2 between 329.1 and 362.9 GHz

claims.hypothesis: Cyanamide is present around solar-type protostars
claims.experiment: LTE line search in ALMA PILS and PdBI data
claims.result: 11 lines toward IRAS16293 B, 3 toward IRAS2A
claims.finding: First detection of NH2CN in solar-type protostars; NHDCN first ISM detection

evidence.quote: This is the first detection of NHDCN in the interstellar medium.

claims.hypothesis: NH2CN and NH2CHO share a precursor

evidence.quote: which may suggest that these two molecules share NH$_2$ as a common precursor

claims.result: Underproduces at high density; 3.7e-10 at low density
claims.finding: Capable with correct physical parameters, but NH2CN/NH2CHO ratio underpredicted

evidence.quote: Grain-surface chemistry appears capable of reproducing the gas-phase abundance of NH$_2$CN with the correct choice of physical parameters.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Gas-phase CN + NH3 rejected; proceeds to HCN + NH2

evidence.quote: An experimental study by (cite: Blitz2009) confirms that this reaction proceeds exclusively to HCN + NH$_2$.

limitations_admitted.value: NH2CN column density in IRAS16293 B is a lower limit due to absorption

evidence.quote: this column density can only be considered as a lower limit, because of the absorption components
